rubric_title: VisionFlow Phase 6 Output Quality Review Rubric
blocking_threshold: Any score <= 2 in Safe Zone, Audio Sync, or Fact Accuracy triggers rejection

dimensions.name: First 3-Second Hook Impact
dimensions.description: Does the visual and audio immediately capture viewer attention without delay or black frames?

dimensions.name: Pacing & Cut Density
dimensions.description: Are cuts dynamic (1.5s - 3.5s per shot)? Is there any frozen frame or dull static hold?

dimensions.name: Visual-Narration Coherence
dimensions.description: Does the visual footage faithfully illustrate what is being narrated by TTS?

dimensions.name: Subtitle Safe-Zone & Readability
dimensions.description: Are captions inside 1080x1920 safe margins (top >= 120px, bottom >= 240px)? Max 3-5 words per chunk?

dimensions.name: Technical Polish & Audio Balance
dimensions.description: Clean 1080x1920 30fps h264/aac video, zero clipping, normalized speech, smooth fade.
